fixture.construction: Six legal turns in a hand-designed one-mon-per-side reduced endgame; no state mutation. Not a six-mon preview or a recorded match. Both move sets occur in the exported per-species legal move lists.
fixture.discovery: First construction failed because Safeguard blocked paralysis and Tackle missed. The next Tackle variant revealed the gap on some seeds; final variant replaces unused Tackle with legal Body Slam to expose the retaliation loss clearly. Search seeds are repeated measurements of this selected fixture, not independent game prevalence.

continuations.policy: After the first move, wait with Thunder Wave until full HP, then Return. Opponent always Counter. Exhausted moves fall back to first legal action. Cap 100 turns.

corpus.all_events: Roar was replaced with Screech or Earthquake by Encore in source battle index 246 at turns 16,17,18,19,24. This establishes move override, not lost strategy value. No mask relaxation inferred.
corpus.limitations: All legal replies under one imputed reconstruction; one random trajectory per action pair, not exhaustive chance. Own sets may contain fabricated moves. The reader cannot certify outcome optimality or all silent effects.

limits: Continuation results use a fixed Counter opponent and a fixed common recovery policy, not optimal play or a full bot-vs-bot strength gate.
One-step loss probabilities enumerate engine chance; continuation win frequencies are Monte Carlo, not certified probabilities.
